content.title: The future is Quantum
content.text: The Second Quantum Revolution is unfolding now, exploiting the enormous advancements in our ability to detect and manipulate single quantum objects. The Quantum Flagship is driving this revolution in Europe. Latest information About the Quantum Flagship The Quantum Flagship was launched in 2018 as one of the largest and most ambitious research initiatives of the European Union. With a budget of at least €1 billion and a duration of 10 years, the flagship brings together research institutions, academia, industry, enterprises, and policy makers, in a joint and collaborative initiative on an unprecedented scale. LEARN MORE What is Quantum Technology? Find out the basics on our dedicated page, including the rest of our Quantum Explained video series. Or take a deeper dive with over 70 educational videos in our curated Quantum Playlist! Did you know?
